how_to_apply: Open the registration format in the Career Section of the RITES website, http://www.rites.com, between 02.11.2026 and 22.11.2026.
Note the Registration No. that the system generates on top of the form. Quote it in all further communication with RITES.
Fill in the details under "Fill/ Modify Application Form", entering the "Identity Proof" details carefully. The same identity proof must be produced in original at later stages.
Give two preferences for the written test centre.
Upload all documents under the "Upload Document" section.
Pay the fee online under the "Make Payment" section, then download the final application form.
Print, sign and keep a copy of the application form, and carry it if called for selection.
Where a post is not reserved for the SC / ST / PwD category, candidates from that category must also pay the full fee during the online application.

The fee paid by SC / ST / PwD candidates is refunded once they take part in the written exam / interview (as applicable). The refund goes to the source account or card, less GST / bank charges, after the category certificate is checked.
SC/ST/PwBD candidates must submit their certificate through the portal at the time of paying the fee to be considered for a refund.
A fee paid by any other mode is not accepted, and such an application is rejected. An application without successful fee payment is treated as incomplete.

content_sections.heading: About RITES
content_sections.text: RITES Ltd. is a Navratna Central Public Sector Enterprise under the Ministry of Railways, Govt. of India. It describes itself as a multi-disciplinary consultancy organisation in transport, infrastructure and related technologies. The notice was issued from its office at Shikhar, Plot No. 1, Sector – 29, Gurgaon – 122001. This recruitment is for professionals on a contract lumpsum basis in the Southern region.

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: All 31 Senior Technical Assistant posts are listed under VC No. CL/12/26 for posting in Andhra Pradesh, Telangana, Karnataka, Kerala, Tamil Nadu, Puducherry & Lakshadweep. Selected candidates are also liable for posting anywhere in India as per Company requirements. The notice states that the number of vacancies may vary. Of these, 02 posts are reserved for PwBD candidates on a horizontal basis: 01 for Cat-b and 01 for Cat-c. No posts are reserved for Cat-a or Cat-d & e.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: General/EWS candidates, and SC/ST/OBC(NCL)/PWD candidates applying against unreserved posts, need a minimum of 50% marks in the minimum educational qualification. Reserved category candidates (SC/ST/OBC(NCL)/PWD, as applicable) need at least 45% marks for consideration against reserved posts. The same applies to candidates with higher qualifications in the same discipline. Candidates with higher qualifications (Degree / PG Degree) in the same discipline are also eligible to apply. The diploma or degree must come from an institution recognised by BTE/AICTE respectively, a university incorporated by a Central or State Act, an institution established by an Act of Parliament, or a university deemed under Section 3 of the University Grants Commission Act, 1956. Sections A & B of the Institution of Engineers (India) examination are also accepted. If a mark sheet does not show the percentage, the candidate must provide the university's conversion formula. If the university has none, an undertaking signed by its authorised representative is required, and a minimum of 5 on a 10-point scale is treated as 50%. Training (except on-the-job training), internship, teaching, academic, fellowship or PhD research experience is not counted as experience. The date of acquiring the qualification is the earliest of the following: the last day of the month of the final examination, the date of the result, the date of the final mark sheet, or the date of the degree. No relaxation is given on this point. The maximum age is 40 years as on the last date of application, i.e. 22.11.2026. Age, experience and all other eligibility criteria are reckoned as on that date. The PwBD relaxation applies whether or not the post is reserved, provided the post is identified as suitable for PwBDs. Only candidates with not less than 40% of the relevant disability get PWD benefits. The post is identified for locomotor disability (OA, OL) and hearing impairment (HI). Physical requirements include sitting, standing, bending, walking, seeing, manipulation by fingers, communication, and reading and writing. Persons with these disabilities may apply even where no vacancy is reserved for them; they are then considered by the general standard of merit. The relaxations are given subject to the required certificates. For the discipline-specific eligibility of the post, candidates should check the official notification.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: The RITES Senior Technical Assistant selection consists of a written test followed by document scrutiny. Appointment also depends on medical fitness. The written test has 125 objective type questions of one mark each, with a duration of 2.5 hours. There is no negative marking. PwBD candidates get a compensatory time of 50 minutes. To be considered further, candidates need a minimum of 50% marks (UR/EWS) or 45% marks (SC/ST/OBC (NCL)/PwBD against reserved posts). The tentative test centres are Chennai, Bangalore, Thiruvananthapuram and Secunderabad. RITES may allot a centre that the candidate did not choose. The exact date, time and venue will be communicated separately. Based on the written test result and the number of vacancies, RITES scrutinises the uploaded documents. A merit list is prepared only for candidates who meet the minimum marks and are shortlisted in the document scrutiny. Offers are then issued provisionally. Original documents are verified at joining, and the offer is cancelled if they cannot be verified. Depending on requirement, the written test, document verification or interview may be held at RITES' Regional Offices. Selected candidates must be found medically fit as per RITES Rules.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in RITES Senior Technical Assistant Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 31 posts: UR 14, EWS 03, OBC (NCL) 08, SC 04 and ST 02. Of these, 02 posts are reserved for PwBD candidates on a horizontal basis.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The last date for the online application and fee payment is 22 November 2026. Applications opened on 02 November 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is required?
faq.answer: Candidates need a Full-Time Diploma in Civil Engineering with 02 years of post-qualification experience in the relevant field of Engineering. The minimum marks are 50% (45% for reserved categories against reserved posts).

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The maximum age is 40 years as on 22.11.2026. SC/ST candidates get 5 years of relaxation, OBC-NCL candidates 3 years, and PwBD candidates an additional 10 years.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of a RITES Senior Technical Assistant?
faq.answer: The approximate monthly gross pay is Rs. 39,137 in Bangalore, Rs. 36,475 in X Class Cities, Rs. 30,808 in Y Class Cities and Rs. 26,218 in Z Class Cities. The basic pay ranges from Rs. 20,644 to Rs. 26,624.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee?
faq.answer: The fee is Rs. 300/- plus taxes for General/OBC candidates and Rs. 100/- plus taxes for EWS/SC/ST/PWD candidates. SC/ST/PwD candidates get a refund after taking part in the further selection process.

faq.question: Q7. When is the written test and is there negative marking?
faq.answer: The written test is tentatively scheduled for 29 November 2026 (Morning Shift). It has 125 one-mark objective questions in 2.5 hours, with no negative marking.

faq.question: Q8. Is the RITES Senior Technical Assistant job permanent?
faq.answer: No. The appointment is purely on contract basis, initially for one year. It is extendable until completion of the assignment, subject to mutual consent and satisfactory performance.

faq.question: Q9. Can I apply for more than one vacancy?
faq.answer: Yes. Candidates may apply for any number of vacancies, but each one needs a separate application. An application cannot be altered once submitted.
